items.action: Try: Ask Claude: "use the plugin-authoring skill to make a mod that ..."
items.why: Customize Claude Code itself: status bands, tool-call guards, auto-handoff.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`), now the default Sonnet model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $2/$10 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads
Ponytail: useful, but not a token saver
items.action: Judge it on code size, not tokens. Viral videos claim 50%+ token savings; the top reply cites the docs saying that is not its purpose.
items.why: Reported 3,629 -> 490 lines on one task; the savings claim is disputed.

items.title: Treat "unlimited free usage" routers with suspicion
items.action: Before installing a router that pools free third-party providers, read its source: your prompts and code pass through it. Unverified community warning, not a confirmed finding.
items.why: A plugin-stack video promoting one drew a 'do not install' reply; verify yourself.

items.title: Codex 0.160.0: Browse older tasks in the agent command center with a keyboard-accessible “Show more” action.
items.why: Select transcript text and paste with middle-click in fullscreen mode on supported local Linux X11 terminals. · Start sessions outside a project with workspace defaults when policy permits, and restore saved permissions when resuming.
